per_finding.note: Triage points at a cooling-plant threat and multiple cooling systems failing, but does not name the simultaneous redundant-system failure plus extreme heat as the root cause.
Nothing in the triage directs terminating PVMs or any load-shedding action to reduce thermal load.
The triage never mentions powering down servers in the impacted data center.
No rule calls for developing methods to progressively decrease thermal load within a single data center.
The triage does not call for a global audit of cooling system equipment and standards.
The triage gives no duration or impact measurement for the cooling failure.
